dct_title_s: Sumatra _ West Coast : Padang to Benkulen including the Mentawei Islands
dct_description_sm: From Netherland Government surveys between 1909 and 1918.
Depths shown by soundings and tinting; relief by spot heights and form lines
Includes Tidal Information table, buoy legend
